info.name: AI Seminar System API
info.description: Production-quality API collection for the AI Assistant based Seminar System. Built with FastAPI, ChromaDB for RAG, and Multi-Agent Orchestration (Maker-Checker-Reviewer) for live doubt resolution.

item.name: Seminar Control
item.description: Endpoints to manage the active seminar state, progress slide flows, and trigger agentic resolution of student doubts.

request.description: Starts a brand-new seminar session, clear any existing session state, and initialize the slide repository and vector storage database for semantic similarity check.
Returns information about the current active seminar session, including active slide ID, titles, notes, speech history, and status flags.

Advances the seminar session to the next slide in sequence. If the active slide has wait_for_doubts enabled, advancing will automatically trigger the RAG retrieval, ranking, agentic doubt drafting/answering cycle before completing the advance.
Manually force the multi-agent system to resolve and answer any pending doubts submitted for the current slide without advancing the slide yet.

item.name: Slides Info
item.description: Endpoints to retrieve slide presentation content, notes, and specific slide detail schemas.

request.description: Retrieve list of all slides stored in the current presentation deck.

variable.description: The numeric ID of the slide to retrieve

request.description: Retrieve detailed properties of a specific slide using its unique numeric ID.

item.name: Student Doubts
item.description: Endpoints to submit student questions/doubts, fetch doubts for a slide, view answered doubts, and run RAG ranking.

request.description: Allows a student or client to submit a new doubt/question. The doubt's slide_id must match the current active slide_id of the running seminar, and that slide must have wait_for_doubts enabled.

variable.description: The slide ID to retrieve doubts for

request.description: Retrieve all doubts (including pending, drafted, or approved status) submitted specifically for the given slide ID.

variable.description: The slide ID to retrieve resolved doubts for

request.description: Retrieve only the approved/resolved doubts (with computed AI answers) for the given slide ID.

query.description: Number of top relevant questions to return
If true, search and rank doubts from the global database pool. If false, search only within doubts submitted for this specific slide.

variable.description: The slide ID whose content/notes will be used for similarity comparison

request.description: Get top N doubts ranked by semantic relevance to the slide contents/notes. Returns doubt details along with similarity score, category categorization (top_n, not_relevant_to_ppt, diff_slide, low_priority), and actions message (e.g. 'answered via RAG', 'will be covered in next slide', etc.)
